text:
alex: heads-up — main turned red right after r-2437 merged, failing job build-e2e-gpu-4, step streaming-kernel-smoke. @maria @jin can someone take a look?

maria: on it, grabbing logs now. which commit / PR exactly?

alex: PR #2437, merge sha 6f8d2b1. CI run: https://ci.internal/runs/31234

ci-bot: build-e2e-gpu-4 failed at 00:12:34, exit code 1. failing step logs: https://ci.internal/logs/31234/streaming-kernel-smoke

jin: quick skim — looks like a CUDA allocation error in seqpad_alloc_test, "cudaMalloc failed: out of memory". small stack snippet in the log, likely memory spike during kernel init.

sam: can someone try a quick rerun? if flaky, might pass. command: `ci retry run 31234 --step streaming-kernel-smoke`

maria: rerun kicked: `ci retry run 31234` (started by maria) :rocket:

ci-bot: rerun #31235 started by maria

ci-bot: rerun #31235 completed — FAIL (same step streaming-kernel-smoke), identical OOM in seqpad_alloc_test

olivia: tagging oncall — @eng-oncall we may need bisect or a revert, breaking main for downstream jobs.

eng-oncall: I can take a bisect. need a known-good and known-bad commit range. alex — do you have last green?

alex: last green on main was 6f8c7a9 (before the merge). bad is 6f8d2b1.

eng-oncall: thanks. plan: bisect between 6f8c7a9..6f8d2b1 locally, will report findings shortly. running `git bisect start 6f8d2b1 6f8c7a9` then automated test script for seqpad_alloc_test.

maria: while bisect runs, quick mitigation idea — reduce GPU memory footprint by setting env var: `export REDWOOD_MEM_LIMIT=6g` in CI container config, patch would be small if we need stopgap.

jin: prefer revert if bisect shows regression introduced by r-2437. that PR touches streaming allocator code, likely culprit.

alex: okay I can open a revert if bisect points to our PR. pinging gitbot to create revert PR now.

gitbot: opened revert PR #2440 (revert r-2437): https://git.internal/pr/2440 — please review/merge if confirmed

sam: +1 to revert if bisect confirms. also recommend marking seqpad_alloc_test as flaky and quarantining until we have a fix.

ci-bot: test seqpad_alloc_test marked unstable and added to flaky quarantine for next 24h by automation rule.

eng-oncall: bisect update — preliminary shows the first bad commit is 6f8d2b1 (r-2437). reproducible locally with the same env. I'll attach the bisect log in the PR.

alex: thanks — I'll shepherd the revert and follow up in the PR thread, and we can iterate on a proper fix in r-2437 branch.

maria: created quick CI patch with REDWOOD_MEM_LIMIT and kicked a smoke run to validate, will monitor.

sam: thanks team. keep me posted if we need an emergency rollback or infra change. :thumbsup:

alex: closing loop — if revert lands we'll run another full build and confirm greens. will update this thread.

maria: update: smoke run with reduced mem passed the streaming-kernel-smoke step locally, pushing patch to CI now.

ci-bot: notification — revert PR #2440 created, and flaky marker applied. further updates will be in the PR thread.
